question: category counts and average confidence for categories with at least 500 POIs
sql:
SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(confidence), 3) AS avg_conf
FROM lisbon_places
GROUP BY basic_category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY n DESC;

question: nearest place per category to city center (-9.14, 38.72) with distance in meters
sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT id, names.primary AS name, basic_category,
         ST_Distance_Spheroid(geometry, ST_Point(-9.14, 38.72)) AS dist_m
  FROM lisbon_places
)
SELECT name, basic_category, ROUND(dist_m, 0) AS dist_m
FROM d
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY basic_category ORDER BY dist_m) = 1
ORDER BY dist_m
LIMIT 20;

question: confidence buckets per category: count of low, medium, high confidence places
sql:
SELECT basic_category,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN confidence < 0.4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_conf,
       SUM(CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.4 AND confidence < 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_conf,
       SUM(CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_conf
FROM lisbon_places
GROUP BY basic_category
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: places whose confidence is above the average for their basic_category, ranked by difference
sql:
WITH cat_avg AS (
  SELECT basic_category, AVG(confidence) AS avg_conf
  FROM lisbon_places
  GROUP BY basic_category
)
SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS name, p.basic_category,
       ROUND(p.confidence, 2) AS conf,
       ROUND(c.avg_conf, 2) AS avg_conf,
       ROUND(p.confidence - c.avg_conf, 2) AS diff
FROM lisbon_places p
JOIN cat_avg c USING (basic_category)
WHERE p.confidence > c.avg_conf
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

question: categories with at least 50 places and average distance from city center less than 2 km
sql:
SELECT basic_category,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(AVG(ST_Distance_Spheroid(geometry, ST_Point(-9.14, 38.72))), 0) AS avg_dist_m
FROM lisbon_places
GROUP BY basic_category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
   AND AVG(ST_Distance_Spheroid(geometry, ST_Point(-9.14, 38.72))) < 2000
ORDER BY avg_dist_m;

question: operating status counts with percentage and report date
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT operating_status, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM lisbon_places
  GROUP BY operating_status
)
SELECT current_date AS asof_date,
       operating_status,
       n,
       ROUND(100.0 * n / SUM(n) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM counts
ORDER BY n DESC;
